topic: remove yellow sweat stains from a white shirt
core_question: How do I get yellow underarm sweat stains out of a white shirt? (secondary: How do I avoid overdraft fees on my checking account?)
answer_summary: Apply a paste of hydrogen peroxide and baking soda to the stained area, let it sit, scrub gently, then launder.; after the topic shift: Set up low-balance text/email alerts through your bank's app, link a savings account for automatic overdraft transfers, or opt out of overdraft coverage entirely so transactions are simply declined instead of incurring a fee.

Those underarm stains are super common—have you ever looked closely at one to figure out whether it's the fabric that's discolored or some kinda buildup on top of the fabric? What does the stain feel like when you touch it?

Yes—a paste would let it sit on the stain and really soak in—so once you've got that paste on there, what do you think would help it work through the buildup—would you just leave it dry, or should you do something to let it absorb?
i guess let it sit? like soak into the stain?

um gently scrub it? then wash it normal?
